rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for distinctive clothing identifying members of a group.

example.english: We have to wear a uniform at work.
example.jyutping: faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 jiu3 zoek3 zai3 fuk6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when things are simply all the same.

example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 bui1 cyun4 bou6 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing consistency with a standard or agreement rather than casual visual sameness.

example.english: The formatting across all the teams must be uniform to meet the standard.
example.traditional: 各組嘅格式要一致，先至符合個標準。
example.jyutping: gok3 zou2 ge3 gaak3 sik1 jiu3 jat1 zi3 sin1 zi3 fu4 hap6 go3 biu1 zeon2
